info.title: H&M Fashion Recommendation API
info.description:
Production-grade API for personalized fashion recommendations. Serves LightGBM LambdaRank scores with SHAP-derived reason codes, NDCG/MAP@12 evaluation results, and A/B experiment utilities.

**Single-worker deployment**: the bundle RSS is ~5.7 GB; multiple workers would each load a full copy. Use a load balancer + single uvicorn worker.
